headline: I build the site. I run the ads. You get the messages.
sub: Websites, Meta and TikTok ads, and the creative behind them, built and run by one person in Karachi.
roleDevLine: Websites and web apps in React and Next.js, with an admin panel you can edit yourself.
roleAdsLine: Meta and TikTok campaigns built to bring people into your WhatsApp.
roleCreativeLine: Graphics, short video and brand visuals, so the ads and the site look like one business.
